question: What supreme ontological status is attributed to the auspicious goddess Śivā?
premises: Śivā is more essential than essence.
Śivā is the source of birth for all worlds.
These attributes establish her supreme status.
inference: Śivā is the most essential principle and the source from which all worlds arise.
plain_english: More essential than essence itself, Śivā is the source of the birth of all worlds.
